question: How are mantras released from curses imposed by divine beings?
premises: Mantras can be bound by curses.
Divine beings are the agents who impose such curses.
Release from these curses is possible.
inference: Mantras are released from the curses that were made by the gods.
uncertainties: The exact ritual means of release is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Mantras are released from the curses which were imposed by the gods.
